datasets.title: PVGIS ERA5 typical year at 22.30 N, 114.17 E
datasets.provider: European Commission, Joint Research Centre, PVGIS 5.3
datasets.underlying_data: ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis / Copernicus Climate Change Service
datasets.review_decision: Redistribution of this original PVGIS output and identified normalization is permitted with retained source/Copernicus attribution and change disclosure; no rights claim for unrelated EPWs or branding.
datasets.modifications: Original EPW bytes unchanged. Derived canonical EPW writes minute 60, normalizes HOLIDAYS/DAYLIGHT SAVING to the pinned reader's plural SAVINGS spelling, trims CSV padding, removes optional BOM and uses LF; all source numeric values/source years retained.
quality_limitations: Gridded reanalysis-derived typical year, not station observations or one actual calendar year
3853 negative unused infrared values and 2 negative unused wind values retained and reported
Separate JSON response DNI differs from EPW in 359 intervals, maximum 10.99; canonical EPW is sole data authority
datasets.redistribution_in_repository: Exact reviewed EPW copied into the repository after independent primary-source rights review; original SHA-256 verified. Retain the source record, this inventory entry and notice when packaging or exporting these data.
